strategy.playbook_saas_platform_plg_customers: SMBs and individual professionals who sign up themselves via free trial.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_plg_growthLever: Paid rate depends on PMF, Quality, & Price. Product virality drives Total Users.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_plg_mainRisk: High churn if product quality drops. Users leave fast when frustrated.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_plg_marketingTip: Organic social and content marketing bring low-CAC signups. Keep investing.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_plg_hiringPriorit: Hire Engineers first to build a reliable product, then Growth Marketers.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_plg_statFocus: Watch PMF Score and Churn. Both must improve together.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_slg_customers: IT leads and VPs at mid-to-large companies. Decisions take months.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_slg_growthLever: Sales pipeline — outbound demos, proposals, and relationship building.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_slg_mainRisk: Long sales cycles. Revenue ramps slowly before the first few big wins.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_slg_marketingTip: PR and brand credibility matter more than viral reach. Build case studies.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_slg_hiringPriorit: Hire Sales first. Your Account Executives close the deals that matter.
strategy.playbook_saas_platform_slg_statFocus: Track Deals Closed and pipeline velocity. Revenue follows deals, not users.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_plg_customers: Developers and indie builders who integrate your API into their apps.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_plg_growthLever: Developer adoption via open-source buzz, docs quality, and API sandbox.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_plg_mainRisk: GPU compute costs are high. You need volume to reach margin.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_plg_marketingTip: Developer content, YouTube demos, and GitHub visibility drive adoption.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_plg_hiringPriority: Engineers first for model quality, then DevRel to grow the community.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_plg_statFocus: Watch Reliability — if your API goes down, developers will switch instantly.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_slg_customers: CIOs and data leaders at large corporations buying bespoke AI deployments.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_slg_mrrFormula: Active Enterprise Contracts × Fixed Solution Price
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_slg_growthLever: High-touch sales and solutions architects who customize deployments.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_slg_mainRisk: Very slow procurement. Deals can take 6-12 months to close.
strategy.playbook_ai_platform_slg_marketingTip: Whitepapers, analyst reports, and LinkedIn thought leadership build credibility.

strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_plg_customers: Individual members paying monthly for entertainment content.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_plg_growthLever: Content quality and hit titles drive word-of-mouth and social buzz.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_plg_mainRisk: Massive content investment needed to reduce churn and keep viewers hooked.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_plg_marketingTi: PR campaigns around new releases + social clips drive organic acquisition.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_plg_hiringPrior: Engineers (for streaming infra reliability) + Marketers (for buzz).
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_plg_statFocus: Churn is your enemy. High churn means great acquisition but poor retention.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_slg_customers: Other streaming platforms, airlines, hotels, and distributors that license your catalog.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_slg_mrrFormula: Active License Deals × Fixed License Fee
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_slg_growthLever: Content partnership and enterprise sales to distributors with large audiences.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_slg_mainRisk: Capped upside per deal. You don't own the end-user relationship.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_slg_marketingTi: Industry events, trade publications, and direct outreach to media buyers.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_slg_hiringPrior: Sales (Content Partnership Managers). More deals = more revenue.
strategy.playbook_ott___streaming_slg_statFocus: Track Deals Closed. Each deal pays a fixed retainer regardless of viewer count.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_plg_customers: Mass-market casual players who download free and optionally pay for IAPs.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_plg_mrrFormula: Ad Revenue (Users × Ad Freq) + IAP Revenue (3% of Users × IAP Value)
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_plg_growthLever: App store ranking, social sharing loops, and influencer reviews.

strategy.playbook_mobile_game_plg_marketingTip: Paid acquisition on Meta/TikTok can scale, but watch ROAS carefully.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_plg_hiringPriority: Engineers for game quality and crash-free experience.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_plg_statFocus: Balance Ad Frequency slider carefully — too high causes churn.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_slg_customers: Movie studios, sports leagues, or brands paying for co-branded game experiences.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_slg_mrrFormula: Active License Contracts × Engine/IP License Fee

strategy.playbook_mobile_game_slg_mainRisk: Royalties cut margin. Creative control is limited by brand requirements.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_slg_marketingTip: Your portfolio of past games and technical demos close deals.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_slg_hiringPriority: Sales (Brand Partnership Managers) + senior Engineers for polished demos.
strategy.playbook_mobile_game_slg_statFocus: Product Quality matters most. Low quality games don't renew contracts.

strategy.playbook_marketplace_slg_marketingTip: White-glove service reputation and case studies attract premium enterprise buyers.

strategy.playbook_marketplace_slg_statFocus: Track Deals Closed. Each managed vendor is a fixed retainer contract.

mentorship.intro_plg.title: 👋 WELCOME, {name}!
mentorship.intro_plg.message:
I'm Sam, {name} — I've backed over a hundred startups in my time. Think of me as your advisor in the passenger seat. I'll check in when things get tricky.

First order of business: keep an eye on your Runway — that's how many months of cash you have left. Let's build something great.
mentorship.intro_slg.title: 👋 WELCOME, {name}!
mentorship.intro_slg.message:
I'm Sam, {name} — I've backed over a hundred startups in my time. Think of me as your advisor in the passenger seat. I'll check in when things get tricky.

First order of business: keep an eye on your Runway — that's how many months of cash you have left. Let's build something great.
mentorship.low_runway.title: RUNWAY ALERT! ⚠️
mentorship.low_runway.message: You have less than 4 months of cash left. This is the 'Default Dead' zone. You need to either 'Pitch Investors' immediately or cut your burn rate. Consider firing non-essential staff or pausing expensive marketing.
mentorship.high_burnout.title: YOU'RE BURNING OUT! 🧘
mentorship.high_burnout.message: Your burnout is over 70%. Your decision-making is suffering, and the team is starting to notice. You must 'Rest and Recharge' this month. A dead founder can't lead a unicorn.
mentorship.hiring_first.title: TIME TO DELEGATE! 👥
mentorship.hiring_first.message: You've got some traction! You can't do everything alone anymore. Hiring your first Engineer will boost product quality passively, but watch your burn. Hire slow, fire fast.
mentorship.scaling_fast.title: STAY AGGRESSIVE! 🚀
mentorship.scaling_fast.message: The fundamentals look solid. You have runway, PMF is improving, and your unit economics are healthy. Now is the time to be bold. Experiment with 'New Marketing Channels' or double down on 'Product Innovation'.
mentorship.consult_profit.title: PROFITS ARE UP! 💰
mentorship.consult_profit.message: You're in the rare group of profitable startups. You can now bootstrap to greatness or raise a 'clean' round with massive leverage. I'd suggest aggressive hiring in Sales to dominate the market.
mentorship.consult_pmf.title: FIX THE PRODUCT 🛠️
mentorship.consult_pmf.message: Your PMF score is low. Marketing right now is like pouring water into a leaky bucket. Stop the ads. Put 100% of your energy into 'Fixing Bugs' and 'MVP Features' until users actually stick.

stats.cash_desc: Your company bank account. When this hits zero, game over. Try to keep at least 3 months of expenses in reserve.
stats.burn_desc: Monthly Profit/Loss. Positive means you are gaining cash; negative (Burn) means you are losing it. Hire a CFO to optimize expenses.
stats.valuation_desc: The estimated market value of your startup. Driven by user growth, revenue, product quality, and market conditions.
stats.runway_desc: How many months you can survive at current burn before running out of cash. ∞ means you are profitable.

financials.ratio_healthy: Ratio of LTV to CAC. 3x+ is healthy business. Hire a CFO to optimize.
financials.cash_desc: Your company bank account. Maintain at least 3 months of runway.
financials.revenue_desc: Total Monthly Revenue. Lifeblood of the business.
financials.valuation_desc: Calculated based on Revenue, growth, and product quality.
financials.runway_desc: Time until cash runs out. Increase this by raising funds or reaching profitability.
financials.gross_margin_desc: Revenue minus direct costs (COGS). Higher is better.
financials.cogs_desc: Cost of Goods Sold. Direct expenses like server costs and API fees.
financials.opex_desc: Operating Expenses. Indirect costs like office rent and software.
financials.net_income_desc: Total monthly profit or loss after all expenses.
financials.cac_desc: Customer Acquisition Cost. Marketing spend per new user.
financials.ltv_desc: Lifetime Value. Total revenue expected from a user.

stats.users_desc: Core metric. Increase through marketing and hiring a great sales team.
stats.paid_users_desc: Number of active users paying for your product.
stats.volume_desc: Total transaction or API volume flowing through your platform.
stats.mrr_desc: Monthly Recurring Revenue. The most important metric for a SaaS business.
stats.growth_desc: Month-over-month revenue growth rate. Investors want to see >10% at early stages.
stats.pq_desc: Product Quality. Impacts conversion, churn, and brand reputation. Boosted by engineers.
stats.debt_desc: Technical Debt. High debt slows development and hurts reliability. Refactor to reduce it.
stats.reliability_desc: System uptime and stability. Drops cause user churn and reputation damage.
stats.brand_desc: Brand Awareness. Higher brand lowers CAC and boosts organic growth. Driven by marketers.
stats.morale_desc: Team Morale. High morale boosts productivity. Low morale causes employee churn.
stats.pmf_desc: Product-Market Fit. The holy grail. Reaching 100 unlocks explosive, efficient scale.

events.investor_update_missed_choice_1: Schedule a call to address it directly
events.investor_update_missed_choice_2: Blame it on being too busy building

events.down_round_pressure_choice_1: Negotiate a flat round with warrants
events.down_round_pressure_choice_2: Aggressively cut costs to extend runway
events.product_hunt_launch_desc: Your product just hit #1 on Product Hunt with 1,200 upvotes. You're getting 500 sign-ups per hour and your servers are straining. The next 24 hours could define your brand.

events.tax_audit_choice_2: Represent yourself — you have the documentation

events.contract_dispute_desc: Your biggest enterprise customer ($8K/mo) is claiming the product doesn't meet SLA requirements and is withholding 3 months of payments.

storyline.storyline_tutorial_0_message:
I've backed over a hundred startups. Most failed — not because of bad ideas, but because their founders didn't know which numbers to watch.

I'm here so you don't make those same mistakes. Think of me as your co-pilot.
storyline.storyline_tutorial_1_message:
This top panel is your cockpit. Watch these every month:

• 💰 Cash & Runway — your lifeline. Zero cash = game over.
• 🔥 Burnout — if this hits 100, you crash.
• 📈 PMF Score — how well you fit the market.
• 👥 Users — your proof of traction.
storyline.storyline_tutorial_2_message:
Each month you get Focus Hours — your most valuable resource. Spend them on one action.

Tap the ⚡ action button at the bottom to see your options. Product, growth, or team — choose carefully.
storyline.storyline_tutorial_3_message:
See the Rivals tab? Open it now. There's a startup called Chadly — that's your competition.

Watch his users and valuation. When Chad shows up in person, you'll know what you're dealing with.
storyline.storyline_tutorial_4_message:
You win by outlasting — not by spending the most.

Grow users, hit PMF, raise smart, stay alive. I'll check in every month for the next 6 months.

And Chad's going to show up. Don't panic when he does.
storyline.storyline_sam_expert_welcome_message: Good to see you again. I know you know the ropes, so I'll skip the tutorial. I'll still be checking in every month to make sure you don't do anything stupid.
storyline.storyline_sam_month_3_message:
Three months in. First thing I want you to check — your runway number.

If you have less than 6 months of cash left and you're not profitable yet, that's a five-alarm fire. Don't wait — reduce burn or start fundraising conversations now.

Cash is oxygen. Never let it surprise you.
storyline.storyline_sam_month_4_message:
You're probably thinking about hiring. Good instinct — but don't rush it.

Hire when a specific bottleneck is costing you users or revenue. Not before. Every salary is a commitment you can't easily unwind.

The best first hires are people who remove constraints, not people who look good on a pitch deck.
storyline.storyline_sam_month_6_message:
If investors are starting to notice you, they'll send signals — intro requests, questions about metrics, casual coffee chats. Don't dismiss these.

But don't let fundraising distract you from building either. One founder focused entirely on pitching while their PMF score collapsed.

Fundraise in parallel, not in place of building.
storyline.storyline_sam_island_farewell_message:
Six months in — and look at you. You know your runway, you've seen Chad's move, and you're still standing.

I think you're ready to sail solo.

I earned a place on my private island doing exactly what I've been teaching you. I'm going there now. But if things get serious — tap 'Consult Sam' and I'll swim back.
storyline.storyline_act1_chad_rebuttal_message: Chad loves to talk. That's all it is. Every company I've backed that Chad-types wrote off went on to raise on their own terms. Don't react. Execute.
storyline.storyline_fundraise_rebuttal_message: Big raises don't equal big results. More money means more pressure, more dilution, more runway to miss the point. Focus on your unit economics — those will outlast any headline funding number.
storyline.storyline_users_rebuttal_message: Chadly has users. You have the right users. Know the difference. One churned-mass user base crashes; one retained power base compounds. Build for retention, not vanity.
storyline.storyline_burnout_support_message: Chad's playing you. He wants you burned out and distracted. The best thing you can do right now is rest. A clear mind makes better decisions than any hustle.
storyline.storyline_valuation_milestone_message: Look at what you've built. That valuation isn't a number on a slide — it's a reflection of real users, real revenue, and real decisions. Chad can't buy that.
storyline.storyline_act3_support_message: You and Chadly are the last ones standing. Everything you've built leads to this moment. Stay disciplined, stay focused. The market will crown the right winner.
storyline.storyline_victory_message: Chadly's valuation is in your rearview mirror. You proved that sustainable beats flashy every single time. I'm proud of what you built — and so should you be.

howToPlay.header_subtitle: Your guide to building a unicorn.
howToPlay.basics_subtitle: You are the CEO of a brand-new startup. Each month you make one key decision — then the simulation runs. Your goal is to grow from an idea into a venture-backed company and eventually exit via Acquisition or IPO.
howToPlay.basics_burn_rate_body: Burn Rate is your monthly cash outflow (salaries, ads, rent). Runway is months until you're out of cash. Hit zero and you go Bankrupt.
howToPlay.basics_focus_body: Every action and program costs Focus Hours. Exceeding your 100h cap accelerates Burnout, which tanks productivity and team morale. Hire to delegate.
howToPlay.basics_loop1: Choose your action from the dashboard (Build, Market, Pitch, etc.)
howToPlay.basics_loop2: Advance the month — the engine processes growth, churn, revenue, and events.
howToPlay.basics_loop3: Rivals move too — they raise money, build features, and may attack you.
howToPlay.basics_loop4: Valuation grows dynamically based on user count, revenue, PMF, and team quality.
howToPlay.basics_store1: Ad-Free Pro: Removes all popup ads and banner ads permanently.
howToPlay.basics_store2: Founder's Starter Pack: Instantly grants $5M cash, +10 employee morale, and removes burnout.
howToPlay.basics_store3: Caffeine IV Drip: Permanently adds +100 Max Focus Hours every single month.
howToPlay.basics_store4: Titan of Industry: Grants $100M cash, permanent 50% discount on M&A/Fundraising, and Ad-Free status.
howToPlay.skills_subtitle: Skill Points (SP) allow you to unlock permanent passive bonuses for your startup. Unlocked skills persist throughout the current game session.
howToPlay.skills_funding_body: Earn +1 SP for every major funding round you close (Seed, Series A, Series B, etc).
howToPlay.skills_user_body: Earn +1 SP when your total users cross 1,000, 10,000, and 100,000.
howToPlay.skills_tenure_body: Earn +1 SP automatically every 12 months you survive in the simulation.
howToPlay.skills_branch_tech_body: Reduces technical debt and improves product reliability/quality passively.
howToPlay.skills_branch_mkt_body: Boosts organic growth, virality, and brand awareness.
howToPlay.skills_branch_lead_body: Increases team morale and improves success in investor pitches.
howToPlay.skills_branch_fund_body: Improves valuation caps and investor pipeline quality.
howToPlay.product_subtitle: Product quality directly affects almost every simulation outcome. A low-quality product bleeds users, stalls virality, and crashes your valuation.
howToPlay.product_quality_body: Raised by building features and refactoring code. Quality above 60 unlocks full viral growth potential. Below 30, users churn heavily and growth is throttled to 20% of normal.
howToPlay.product_pmf_body: PMF reflects how well users love your product. It grows automatically as quality improves and users engage. Low PMF (<45) adds +10% monthly churn on top of your base rate.
howToPlay.product_debt_body: Building features too fast accumulates Tech Debt. High debt drops reliability, triggers server crisis events, and limits how high your Quality can reach.
howToPlay.product_insight_title: Key Insight: Bad Products Can't Go Viral
howToPlay.product_insight_body: The viral multiplier only kicks in when Quality > 50 AND PMF > 15. Fix the product first, then market it.
howToPlay.industries_subtitle: Every industry is governed by different physical laws. Select one below to see how its business models function.
howToPlay.industries_hidden_body: Profit margins are not flat. AI Platforms suffer from GPU compute COGS. FinTech carries high regulatory costs. OTT burns cash on CDN delivery. Scale carefully.
howToPlay.industries_saas_desc: Software as a Service. High margins, predictable recurring revenue.
howToPlay.industries_ai_desc: Cutting-edge intelligence. High compute costs but massive scaling potential.
howToPlay.industries_fintech_desc: Banking and payments. Trust-dependent, regulated, volume-driven revenue.
howToPlay.industries_game_desc: Entertainment first. Hit-driven with complex monetization levers.
howToPlay.industries_marketplace_desc: Connecting buyers and sellers. Hard to start (cold-start), huge network effects.
howToPlay.industries_ott_desc: Media and content. Reliability is king, high infrastructure burn.
howToPlay.industries_devtools_desc: Building for builders. Reliability and word-of-mouth are everything.
howToPlay.industries_edtech_desc: Digital learning. Completion rates drive reputation and referrals.
howToPlay.growth_subtitle: When you create your startup, you choose a Go-To-Market strategy. This fundamentally changes how users, leads, and revenue are calculated.
howToPlay.growth_viral_sub: Self-Serve SaaS · F2P Viral · Community Marketplace · Consumer Neo-bank
howToPlay.growth_viral2: Revenue comes from converting free → paid via PMF & pricing
howToPlay.growth_viral3: Viral growth multiplies when Quality > 50 and PMF > 30
howToPlay.growth_viral5: Churn is your enemy — bad product empties the bucket
howToPlay.growth_sales_sub: Enterprise SaaS · Branded IP Game · Managed Marketplace · B2B Finance API
howToPlay.growth_sales1: Growth metric = B2B Leads → Active Deals → Closed Won
howToPlay.growth_sales3: Sales team skill directly drives win rate
howToPlay.growth_sales4: Hire a CFO to activate the Fundraising Roadshow
howToPlay.growth_sales5: Slow but sticky: enterprise clients rarely churn
howToPlay.funding_subtitle: Managing your company's balance sheet and your personal net worth is key to scaling. Dilute carefully to raise capital, and reinvest personal gains to grow your brand.
howToPlay.funding_fundraising_body: Use "Pitch Investors" to build your pipeline, then negotiate term sheets. Investors give you cash in exchange for equity. Once diluted, you cannot buy back equity until post-IPO.
howToPlay.funding_board_body: Raising institutional rounds forms a Board of Directors. If you want to increase your personal Founder Salary, you must submit a proposal. Board members vote based on cash burn, runway, and growth rate.
howToPlay.funding_options_body: Grant yourself Executive Stock Option Plans via Board approval to receive additional equity vesting over time. You can exercise these options to gain common shares, or leverage your existing equity as collateral for Margin Loans to get personal cash.
howToPlay.funding_compliance_body: Avoid compliance investigations when selling founder equity. Set up a 10b5-1 Plan in the Compliance tab to schedule automated, secondary sales of your shares for safe personal cash.
howToPlay.funding_debt_body: Once you reach Series A, you can access non-dilutive capital through Venture Debt or Revenue-Based Loans. This provides runway without giving up equity, but requires monthly interest and principal payments.
howToPlay.funding_treasury_body: Put idle corporate or personal cash to work by investing in the Stock Market. Build a portfolio to generate yield, or engage in Options Trading once your company is public.
howToPlay.funding_lifestyle_body: Spend your personal cash on luxury estates, supercars, yachts, or philanthropy. Upgrading your lifestyle raises your Founder Brand Score, which passively attracts better employee candidates and lowers marketing CAC.
howToPlay.funding_ir1: Monthly Investor Updates: Costs nothing. Adds +1 Reputation/mo.
howToPlay.funding_ir2: CFO Roadshow: Replaces the Consultant once you hire a CFO. Zero extra cost, higher investor lead volume.
howToPlay.funding_valuation_body: Your valuation grows dynamically with Revenue × ARR Multiple × PMF Factor × Team Score. A company with high revenue but low PMF will be worth less than a high-PMF competitor at the same revenue level.
howToPlay.team_subtitle: Every employee has a role, a salary, and a skill level that directly impacts the simulation — not just as a headcount number.
howToPlay.team_engineers_effect: Clear tech debt passively. The higher the skill, the more debt removed monthly.
howToPlay.team_marketers_effect: Increase brand awareness and organic user growth. Reduce CAC over time.
howToPlay.team_sales_effect: In Enterprise mode, their combined skill score drives pipeline win-rate directly. In Viral/Self-Serve, they boost conversion by up to +50% per 100 skill points.
howToPlay.team_designers_effect: Raise product quality by improving UX and reducing friction.
howToPlay.team_cpo_desc: Accelerates product features and reduces time-to-quality.
howToPlay.team_cto_desc: Passively reduces tech debt at 2× the rate of standard engineers.
howToPlay.team_cmo_desc: Boosts brand awareness multiplier. Reduces ad spend waste.
howToPlay.team_coo_desc: Reduces founder burnout accumulation. Increases team morale floor.
howToPlay.team_cfo_desc: Reduces burn rate by 10%. Unlocks the Fundraising Roadshow program.
howToPlay.team_ea_desc: Expands your monthly focus capacity, letting you run more actions.
howToPlay.competitors_subtitle: You operate in a competitive market. Rivals make moves every month — and so does your AI mentor/rival character Chadly.
howToPlay.competitors_tactic_talent_effect: Attempts to hire your employees away
howToPlay.competitors_tactic_feature_effect: Raises rival's quality and threat level
howToPlay.competitors_tactic_fundraise_effect: Extends their runway, increases their pressure
howToPlay.competitors_manda_body: You can acquire competitor companies directly to absorb their users, cash, and market share! Go to the Market menu, view active rivals, and make an acquisition offer. If successful, their entire user base is merged into your startup, and they become a Subsidiary that you can actively manage for additional synergies and revenue streams. (Titan owners get a permanent 50% cash discount on M&A acquisitions).
howToPlay.ending_subtitle: Building a huge company leads to the ultimate test: liquidating your ownership through an Acquisition or taking the company public on the stock exchange.
howToPlay.ending_ipo_body: Take your company public on the stock exchange. Requires hitting $50M ARR, 10k+ users, PMF ≥ 60, and Series A raised. Run the IPO Roadshow to build demand, price your stock, and list on the ticker.
howToPlay.ending_manda_body: A strategic buyer approaches you with a buyout offer based on your current valuation. You can negotiate the payout. Payout is typically 5-10x your ARR.
howToPlay.ending_earnings_body: Every 3 months post-IPO, you must host an Earnings Call. Present your financial results to Wall Street and answer analyst questions. Keeping analyst sentiment high drives your stock price up, while poor reporting or bad answers will trigger sell-offs.
howToPlay.ending_lobbying_body: Hire lobbyists in the Compliance tab to influence regulation. Lobbying Congress shields your company from heavy fines when navigating lawsuits, auditing investigations, or antitrust crackdowns from regulators.
howToPlay.ind_saas_viral_drivers: PMF vs. Pricing Tension. Early-game "Honeymoon" multipliers help early growth.
howToPlay.ind_saas_viral_tip: Keep pricing low relative to PMF early to maximize conversion.
howToPlay.ind_saas_sales_formula: Revenue = Active Contracts × Annual Contract Value (ACV)
howToPlay.ind_saas_sales_drivers: Win Rate is driven 50% by Sales Team skill and 50% by Product Quality.
howToPlay.ind_saas_sales_tip: Enterprise deals pay 12 months upfront. Great for cash flow!
howToPlay.ind_ai_viral_formula: Revenue = Paid Users × Token Usage × Price
howToPlay.ind_ai_viral_drivers: Token Volume scales with Innovation Score and Team technical power.
howToPlay.ind_ai_viral_tip: Innovation drives usage. Keep your Engineers building hits.
howToPlay.ind_ai_sales_drivers: Very low base win rate. Requires highly skilled Solution Architects.
howToPlay.ind_ai_sales_tip: Each contract is worth 10x your base price. Big fish only.
howToPlay.ind_fintech_viral_drivers: Transaction Volume depends heavily on PMF (Trust) and quality.
howToPlay.ind_fintech_viral_tip: Regulatory compliance overhead adds to your monthly burn.
howToPlay.ind_fintech_sales_formula: Revenue = Platform Deals × Bulk Transaction Fees
howToPlay.ind_fintech_sales_drivers: Enterprise clients value Reliability above all else. 0% downtime = 100% renewal.
howToPlay.ind_fintech_sales_tip: A single reliability outage in FinTech can trigger massive churn.
howToPlay.ind_game_viral_drivers: Ad Intensity (Slider) increases revenue but destroys PMF and spikes churn.
howToPlay.ind_game_viral_tip: Check your Ad Intensity! Past 40%, users start quitting in droves.
howToPlay.ind_game_sales_formula: Revenue = License Contracts × Monthly Franchise Fee
howToPlay.ind_game_sales_drivers: Fixed revenue per brand deal. High Reputation helps close big IPs.
howToPlay.ind_game_sales_tip: You don't own the users here; you own the contract. Sticky but slower growth.
howToPlay.ind_marketplace_viral_formula: Revenue = Users × GMV per User × Take Rate %
howToPlay.ind_marketplace_viral_drivers: Network Effects log-scale bonus: revenue per user GROWS as your base grows.
howToPlay.ind_marketplace_viral_tip: Cross 10,000 users to unlock the first tier of exponential network effects.
howToPlay.ind_marketplace_sales_formula: Revenue = Active Vetted Contracts × Retainer Fee
howToPlay.ind_marketplace_sales_drivers: Operations-intensive. Vetting quality dictates how much suppliers pay to be listed.
howToPlay.ind_marketplace_sales_tip: High COGS (30%+) due to manual vetting and supply-side management.
howToPlay.ind_ott_viral_drivers: High infrastructure burn (CDN). Quality/Content determines conversion.
howToPlay.ind_ott_viral_tip: Reliability is critical. If content buffers, users cancel immediately.
howToPlay.ind_ott_sales_formula: Revenue = License Deals × Periodic Renewal Fee
howToPlay.ind_ott_sales_drivers: Sales-driven content distribution to larger platforms/airlines/hotels.
howToPlay.ind_ott_sales_tip: Lower upside than consumer, but much lower infrastructure cost.
howToPlay.ind_devtools_viral_drivers: Developer word-of-mouth (Virality) is unusually high (8x multiplier).
howToPlay.ind_devtools_viral_tip: Developers hate bugs. Reliability is the lead growth engine here.
howToPlay.ind_devtools_sales_drivers: SOC2, Security, and Compliance features close these deals.
howToPlay.ind_devtools_sales_tip: Standard engineers can't build these; hire Senior Sales AEs.
howToPlay.ind_edtech_viral_drivers: PMF (Student Success) above 60 unlocks major viral referrals.
howToPlay.ind_edtech_viral_tip: Help students graduate! Completion rates drive your organic growth rate.
howToPlay.ind_edtech_sales_formula: Revenue = Active Seat Licenses × Per-Seat Price
howToPlay.ind_edtech_sales_drivers: Winning multi-seat contracts at universities or HR departments.
howToPlay.ind_edtech_sales_tip: Long procurement cycles. You need a CFO to handle these contracts.
